findings.title: The intended care moves without haste
findings.claim: The verb of divine intending can carry a gentle, unhurried movement toward the boys' eventual benefit, making the delay part of the care's manner as well as its timing.
findings.mechanism: The focus verb at 18:82:15:2 assigns the intended sequence to the Lord; 12:21 independently presents unforeseen protection and eventual household benefit, returning a patient providential movement through the focus intention and maturation sequence.
findings.reader_payoff: The plan's pace becomes perceptible: protection works by allowing the recipients to grow into the moment rather than forcing the benefit into the present.
findings.containment: This preserves the explicit will and outcome of the focus. It does not claim that every use of the verb is slow or that delay means indecision.

epistemic.reason: The focus carrier and exact 12:21 target are supplied, but the slow-movement facet is a bounded contextual resonance inferred from the reviewed providential parallel.
